programs.desc: . A Chinese woman living in Japan holds gatherings for Chinese children with the goal of boosting their confidence in their international background.

programs.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
programs.desc: . Food waste is a major driver of global warming. One institute warns that greenhouse gas emissions from food waste exceed those of nations like India and Russia. We examine the data behind this issue.

programs.desc: , Episode 7, Season 2. Hishikawa Seiichi (Video and craft artist) visits Tottori. Dyeing firms make fishing flags with vivid, hand-drawn designs that carry the feelings of both fishermen and people sending them gifts.

programs.title: The Factory Wonders
programs.desc: . Our team visits a heat-resistant glass factory in Koga, Ibaraki Pref., to witness the skills of the glassblowers and lampworkers, and learn about the secrets that heat-resistant glass holds.

programs.title: Time-lapse Japan
programs.desc: . Delicious Tosa bonito spoils easily and its flavour can vary a lot. Fishmongers at a local port know exactly how to spot the best ones. Watch them in action in time-lapse.

programs.title: Nhk Newsline
programs.desc: . NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programs.title: BOSAI: Science that Can Save Your Life
programs.desc: , Episode 20. What is causing the frequent torrential rain and floods in Japan? Linear rainbands. Find out why this phenomenon is hard to predict and the latest research on forecasting linear rainbands.
